title: Take This Insect's Shell and It Rebuilds One From Gold
subject: caddisfly larva

scenes.text: Take its house, and this insect rebuilds with gold.
It's a caddisfly larva. In streams, it glues sand grains and plant bits together with silk.
French artist Hubert Duprat removed their cases and gave them gold spangles instead.
The larvae spun silk and fixed every spangle into a brand new case.
Later he added pearls, opals, rubies, even diamonds. They built with many of them.
In the stream, sand. In the studio, a jewel box.

description:
Caddisfly larvae build cases from whatever is around them, so artist Hubert Duprat gave them gold and gems.
They fixed the gold spangles with silk into jeweled cases.
What would you give them?
first_comment: If you were handed gold and pearls, would you build with them or keep them?
